description:
List new-build projects in Cyprus that match every filter given, 10 at a time (pass `offset` to go
on). `city`, `district` and `developer` take a name in any language or an ailiste id; a
district includes its quarters. `bedrooms` keeps buildings that have homes of that size (0 = studio).
`stage`: plot, groundworks, frame, closed (walls and windows in), finished, lived_in, stalled - or
under_construction, or ready. `delivered_by` is a year. `seen_by_us` keeps the buildings our team has
stood at. Those come first in any list. Homes handed over before 2020 are not listed.

bedrooms.description: Only buildings with homes of this many bedrooms. 0 is a studio.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

city.description: Only this city: Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia or Famagusta - its name in any language, or its ailiste id.
city.title: City

delivered_by.description: Only buildings to be handed over by the end of this year, such as 2027. A building with no delivery date is left out.
delivered_by.title: Delivered By

developer.description: Only this developer's buildings - its name in any language, or its ailiste id.
developer.title: Developer

district.description: Only this district or village - its name in any language, or its ailiste id. A district includes its quarters.
district.title: District

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

offset.description: How many buildings to skip: 0 for the first 10, then the next_offset an answer gives.
offset.title: Offset

sea_view.description: Only buildings with a view of the sea.
sea_view.title: Sea View

seen_by_us.description: Only buildings our team has stood at, with our own photographs and the day.
seen_by_us.title: Seen By Us

stage.description: Only buildings at this stage: plot, groundworks, frame, closed (walls and windows in), finished, lived_in or stalled. under_construction is groundworks, frame or closed; ready is finished or lived_in.
stage.title: Stage

name: find_buildings
title: Find new buildings
